name: check_seen
description: Check whether titles can be recommended: can_pick is false for anything watched, started, dropped or hidden on Trakt, disliked, not interested or marked seen (excluded says which). Also answers plays, a show's progress, the user's rating and whether it's liked, in the library or on the watchlist. Check every title that didn't come from get_candidates.

titles.description: The titles to check, at most 50.
